name: appkeys
author: jamesd7788
description: Workspaces are apps. Hold caps and press a key to jump to an app; if it isn't running it opens alone on a fresh workspace. caps+shift brings it to you, caps+enter binds whatever is focused. The bar widget swaps workspace numbers for the apps on them and their keys.

barWidget.description: One button per workspace, labelled with its apps and their caps keys. Click to go there. Needs appkeys' install.sh for the keys.
